contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman barbarous radiate, copying a coin of Victorinus (AD 269-271), dating to the period c.AD 275-285 (Reece period 14). [M?]IIRS-O-C reverse type depicting Mars walking left holding transverse spear and trophy(?). Prototype of Mint II. This coin is probably copying a MARS VLTOR reverse type of Victorinus (cf.
